## Hotfix:
- Main interface card width stalling on ultra-wide windows (by @MovTery)
- Touch coordinate offset after closing page fullscreen (by @MovTery)


## Updates:
- GP#1891: Updated mod data (by @MovTery)
- GP#1892: Use relevance sorting when searching translation keywords in Chinese (by @MovTery)
- GP#1897: Added resource favorites feature to the download screen (by @MovTery)
- GP#1906: Added game argument configuration options (by @MovTery)
- GP#1925: Updated Vulkan detection (26.4-snapshot-1) (by @MovTery)
- GP#1926: Removed custom home page, added card-based main interface system (by @MovTery)
- GP#1934: Main interface action menu bar supports long-press drag to switch sides (by @MovTery)


## Refactors:
- GP#1911: Version encapsulates game directory, version chain paths now provided by Version instances (by @MovTery)
- GP#1929: Refactored downloader engine, referencing HMCL FetchTask (by @MovTery)

## Changes:
- GP#1885: Adjusted Java runtime selection dialog style (by @youfeng11)
- GP#1889: Expand compatible versions by default in the version list when downloading mods (by @youfeng11)
- GP#1897: Resource platform badges now distinguished by platform brand colors (by @MovTery)


## Fixes:
- GP#1884: Unified single initialization of LWJGL natives paths, auto re-extract when self-check detects missing files before launch (by @MovTery)
- GP#1890: Added SDL dlsym layer proxy, destroy gating covers reused windows (by @MovTery)
- GP#1898: Abnormally long author names displayed incorrectly on the download screen (by @MovTery)
- GP#1905: Byte-by-byte boxing during mod fingerprint scanning causes GC pressure and slow loading when loading installed mods (by @MovTery)
- GP#1906: Misaligned game arguments and JVM arguments when importing/exporting MCBBS modpacks (by @MovTery)
- GP#1923: Completed paired sending of key and character events, fixing Cleanroom letter keys and chat input not working (by @MovTery)
- GP#1920: Some systems scale app windows, causing decorView size to differ from physical display size and leading to multi-touch coordinate offset (by @Leowly)
- GP#1932: Fixed physical mouse movement being dispatched as key events after switching system input method (by @MovTery)

## hotfix:
- 超宽窗口下主界面卡片宽度停滞 (by @MovTery)
- 关闭页面全屏化后触摸坐标偏移 (by @MovTery)


## 更新：
- GP#1891：更新模组数据 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1892：中文搜索翻译关键词时固定使用相关性排序 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1897：下载屏幕新增资源收藏功能 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1906：加入游戏参数配置项 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1925：更新 Vulkan 检测 (26.4-snapshot-1) (by @MovTery)
- GP#1926：移除自定义主页，加入卡片式主界面系统 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1934：主界面操作菜单栏支持长按提起拖拽换边 (by @MovTery)


## 重构：
- GP#1911：Version 封装游戏目录，版本链路路径由 Version 实例提供 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1929：重构下载器引擎，参考 HMCL FetchTask (by @MovTery)


## 调整：
- GP#1885：调整选择Java运行时对话框样式 (by @youfeng11)
- GP#1889：下载模组时模组版本列表默认展开适配的版本 (by @youfeng11)
- GP#1897：资源平台标识标签按平台品牌色区分 (by @MovTery)


## 修复：
- GP#1884：统一 LWJGL natives 路径单次初始化，启动前自检缺失时自动重解包 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1890：新增 SDL dlsym 层代理，销毁门控覆盖复用窗口 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1898：下载屏幕内，平台项目作者名称太长时，显示异常 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1905：加载已安装模组时，模组指纹扫描逐字节装箱导致 GC 压力与加载缓慢 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1906：MCBBS 整合包游戏参数与 JVM 参数导入导出错位 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1923：补齐按键与字符事件成对发送，修复 Cleanroom 字母键与聊天输入失效 (by @MovTery)
- GP#1920：部分系统会对应用窗口做缩放，decorView 尺寸与物理显示尺寸不一致，导致多指触控坐标偏移 (by @Leowly)
- GP#1932：修复切换系统输入法后实体鼠标移动被当作按键事件下发 (by @MovTery)
